answer: According to the EDPB Statement 3/2024, data protection authorities (DPAs) must be designated as market surveillance authorities for high-risk AI systems listed in point 1 of Annex III of the AI Act, particularly when those systems are used for law enforcement purposes, border management, and justice and democracy. The EDPB also recommends that DPAs should act as the single points of contact for the public and counterparts at Member State and Union levels.
